services.desc: With a mix of bagpipes, fiddles, accordions, guitar and vocals, underpinned by driving bass, drums and keys, Skerryvore represent the best in contemporary Scottish traditional music. Four-time winners of Scotland’s Live Act of the Year Award, Skerryvore’s musicians bring a wide range of influences to the mix, creating a unique fusion of celtic, folk, trad, pop and rock. Kentucky K-12 public schools are eligible to receive FREE student tickets thanks to the Norton Center’s Arts for the Classroom Ticket Subsidy (ACTS) program.
